replies.excerpt: Fixed in 7d037b07d. The thinking level now stays with the model it was set for. Switching models drops it, and the new model starts on its own level: whatever you picked for it earlier in the session…

en.headline: 12 own commits, 24 automated, one issue comment and a new discussion
en.summary: On 2026-10-18 sogeisetsu made **12 own commits** across three repositories, plus 24 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. The 7 commits in `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin (`list`/`inspect`/`disable`/`enable`), revised the spec, moved plans to `.openchamber/plans` and corrected the `plugin add` entry-point conclusion. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` the 4 commits stopped duplicate creation of the resident issue, narrowed the `verify` script's additive-wording check, degraded the page when the `notifier` fails, and reworked AI failure visibility, model labeling and the 30-day summary. One commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added an `opencode-provider` knowledge category on `catalog` sources, credential ownership and endpoints. sogeisetsu commented on `openchamber/openchamber` #4939 about the render-page selection menu and received two replies: #4601 was fixed in `7d037b07d`, while #4899 could not be reproduced. `btriapitsyn` closed #4896, #4920 and #4601, and sogeisetsu started discussion #5114 proposing to split the rendered-page selection-menu fix.

zh.headline: 12 次本人提交、24 次自动提交，1 条 issue 评论并新开 1 个讨论
zh.summary: 2026-10-18，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共完成 **12 次本人提交**，另有 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 产生的 24 次自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 的 7 次提交实现了 `skill_management` 插件（`list`/`inspect`/`disable`/`enable`），修订了规范，把计划移到 `.openchamber/plans`，并更正了 `plugin add` 入口的结论。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 4 次提交修复了常住 issue 被重复创建的问题，收窄了 `verify` 脚本对「相加表述」不变式的扫描范围，让 `notifier` 失败时页面优雅降级，并改版了 AI 失败可见性、模型标注与 30 天总结。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 1 次提交新增了 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涵盖 `catalog` 来源、凭据归属与端点。在 issue 方面，sogeisetsu 评论了 `openchamber/openchamber` #4939（渲染页选中文字无法打开评论菜单），并收到两条回复：#4601 已在 `7d037b07d` 中修复，#4899 无法复现。`btriapitsyn` 关闭了 #4896、#4920 和 #4601，sogeisetsu 还新开了讨论 #5114，提议先拆分渲染页选中菜单的修复。
